data.title: 阿斯特蕾亚 · 晨曦窗边纯白蕾丝的无邪伸展
data.description: 初升晨曦洒满卧室窗棂，阿斯特蕾亚穿着纯白蕾丝吊带背心，背靠窗框惬意舒展双臂，白羽羽毛在微风中轻舞。
data.action: 单腿微屈靠在窗台，双手上举拉伸纤细腰身，纯白羽翼轻展接纳朝阳
data.lighting: 金白晨光自窗外逆光斜射，为金色发丝与纯白羽翼勾勒金边
data.camera: 中景三分之二身位，侧逆光营造梦幻通透感
data.promptProse: Astraea awakens gracefully beside a sun-drenched bedroom window, extending her slender arms upward in a luxurious morning stretch. Dressed in a sheer white lace camisole with delicate floral embroidery, her snowy feathered wings unfurl softly behind her to catch the golden dawn. Beams of early sunlight filter across her golden locks and porcelain skin, creating an ethereal and intimate morning silhouette.
data.animaCaption: Dawn sunlight outlines Astraea's white feathers as she stretches luxuriously beside the open window in her sheer lace camisole.
